title: Is F45 Worth It in NZ? — Honest Review for 2026
meta_desc: Find out if F45 NZ is worth the cost, with honest pricing and contract reviews for 2026
intro: With over 30 locations across New Zealand, F45 has become a household name in the fitness industry, but is it worth the investment? F45 in NZ costs between $60-$80 per week, depending on the location and membership type. In this review, we'll dive into the details of F45's pricing, contract terms, and alternatives to help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: F45 Pricing in NZ
sections.body: F45 studios in NZ offer various membership options, with prices ranging from $60 to $80 per week. The most popular membership, the 'F45 8 Week Challenge', costs around $69 per week, while the 'F45 Unlimited' membership costs around $79 per week. It's worth noting that prices may vary depending on the location, with studios in major cities like Auckland and Wellington tend to be more expensive than those in smaller towns.

sections.heading: Contract Terms and Conditions
sections.body: F45 memberships in NZ typically come with a minimum 2-3 month contract term, after which you can cancel or change your membership type with 30 days' notice. Some studios may offer month-to-month memberships, but these often come with a higher weekly rate. It's essential to review the contract terms and conditions carefully before signing up to ensure you understand the commitment you're making.

sections.heading: F45 vs HIIT Alternatives in NZ
Who is F45 Best For?
sections.body: F45 is an excellent option for those who enjoy high-intensity interval training (HIIT) and want to see quick results. The workouts are designed to be challenging and engaging, with a strong focus on community and accountability. However, F45 may not be the best fit for those on a tight budget or who prefer more flexible contract terms.

sections.heading: Conclusion and Next Steps
sections.body: Ultimately, whether F45 is worth it in NZ depends on your individual fitness goals, budget, and preferences. If you're looking for a challenging and engaging workout experience with a strong community focus, F45 may be an excellent choice. However, if you're on a tight budget or prefer more flexible contract terms, you may want to explore alternative options.
